ebony: Ebony is a deep black colour.
The bathroom has marble tiles and a beautiful ebony tub.
Ebony is a very hard very dark wood, often used for black piano keys.
ebullient: An ebullient person is someone who is very enthusiastic.
ebb: The ebb is the receding movement of the tide.
If a tide ebbs, it flows back out to sea.
If something ebbs, it decreases gradually.
